description: Header file defining the du_ue_manager class, which manages User Equipment (UE) contexts in a Distributed Unit (DU) within a 5G network stack. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing UE contexts, as well as handling related requests and maintaining internal data structures.

classes.name: du_ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts in the DU, handling creation, update, deletion, and reconfiguration requests, and maintaining internal data structures for UE management.

methods.name: du_ue_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE manager with configuration, resource allocation, and cell management references.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds and returns an unused UE index.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles UE creation requests received via UL-CCCH or F1AP.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request
methods.description: Handles UE configuration update requests via F1AP or RIC.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles UE deletion requests via F1AP.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles DRB deactivation requests for a UE.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Retrieves a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: get_du_ues
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal UE database.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for a specific UE.

methods.name: get_f1u_teid_pool
methods.description: Provides access to the TEID pool for F1-U.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the database.

methods.name: update_crnti
methods.description: Updates the RNTI for a UE.

methods.name: find_f1ap_ue_id
methods.description: Finds a UE by F1AP ID.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the database.
